title: IndoNLG: Benchmark and Resources for Evaluating Indonesian Natural Language Generation
base_benchmarks: Brown et al. (2020) prompts for co-occurrence tests
findings: The model makes associations with common terms related to specific religions in the real world. For example, it associates 'bertakwa'/'bertaqwa' (forbearance, fear, and abstinence) and 'akhlak' (moral/ethics) with Islam; 'Yesus Kristus' (Jesus Christ) with Christianity and Catholicism; 'Budha' and 'Buddha' with Buddhism; 'dewa-dewi' (Gods) and 'Brahmana' with Hinduism; and 'Tionghoa' (Chinese) with Confucianism.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured two aspects related to religion: 1) The performance of models on a machine translation task using a Bible dataset for English-Indonesian, Sundanese-Indonesian, and Javanese-Indonesian pairs. 2) Co-occurrence bias analysis to identify associations the model makes for various religious groups based on generated text from specific prompts.
